subject: Retest scheduling & evidence transfer for Greenline pen-test remediation
messages:
From: Peter Ong <peter.ong@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Greenline Security <security@greenlinehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Retest & verification for penetration findings — Greenline integration

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for working with us on the remediation for the June engagement. Our engineering team has pushed fixes addressing the critical and high findings you flagged during the initial pen test. The remediation summary is attached (Greenline_remediation_summary.docx) and includes patch IDs, PR links, and short runs of unit test results.

We need Redwood to:
- Perform a focused retest of the corrected findings (auth bypass, API input validation, and connector isolation).
- Produce a short delta report describing whether those findings remain exploitable.
- Provide a verification letter / attestation we can present to our SOC 2 auditor if the retest confirms closure.

Please confirm scope, proposed start dates for the retest, and any evidence you need uploaded to your portal. We can provide a sandbox environment and temporary credentials.

Attached: Greenline_remediation_summary.docx (remediation details)

Regards,
Peter Ong
InfoSec Lead, Greenline Health
security@greenlinehealth.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Peter Ong <peter.ong@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Retest & verification for penetration findings — Greenline integration

Peter — thanks for the summary and the attachments. We received the remediation package.

On Fri, Jun 18, 2027 at 09:12 AM Peter Ong <peter.ong@greenlinehealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks for working with us on the remediation for the June engagement. Our engineering team has pushed fixes addressing the critical and high findings you flagged during the initial pen test...

Quick replies / proposed plan:
1) Scope: we will retest auth bypass, API validation, and connector isolation as you requested. We will not re-run full web app smoke tests unless you ask — this keeps the window short.
2) Proposed retest window: Tue/Wed Jun 29–30 (09:00–17:00 PT). Please confirm availability.
3) Deliverables: short delta report within 3 business days after the retest; verification letter (signed PDF) if issues are closed; listing of any remaining low/medium findings.
4) Evidence: we need your sandbox URL, test credentials, and confirmation that the patched builds are deployed to the environment. If you prefer, use the secure upload link (see below) for artifact transfer.

I attached our short process overview (retest_process_overview.pdf) — it outlines retest steps and what we include in the delta report. If that looks good, we’ll lock the dates and share an internal runbook and JIRA ticket that will track the work and findings.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Security Liaison, Redwood Inference
From: Peter Ong <peter.ong@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Greenline Security <security@greenlinehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Retest & verification for penetration findings — Greenline integration

Jordan — we can do Jun 29–30. Thanks for the clarity on scope. A few items from our side:

- Scope confirmation: auth endpoints (POST /auth/login, /auth/refresh), internal API surface used by the Redwood connector, and the connector’s network isolation rules. Please avoid load tests; this is a verification retest only.
- Environment: sandbox.greenline.internal (https://sandbox.greenline.internal) with creds below (rotated on 28 Jun):
   user: redwood_retest@greenline.internal
   pwd: (shared via secure channel)
- Attachments: remediation-patch-ids.csv (list of deployed patches and platform CVE references)
- Pre-retest checklist: please confirm that your team will validate the following before starting: config flags, feature toggles, and that the KV cache used by connectors is cleared.

Forwarding your process doc to our SecOps and scheduling the window now. Please send the upload link for evidence and the JIRA ticket once created.

Thanks,
Peter

> On Fri, Jun 18, 2027 at 11:05 AM Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Peter — thanks for the summary and the attachments. We received the remediation package.
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Peter Ong <peter.ong@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 14:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Retest scheduling & evidence transfer for Greenline pen-test remediation

Peter / Greenline SecOps — all set on our side. Summary of confirmation and next steps:

- Retest window: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 at 09:00 PT — start time confirmed for our red-team to verify the three corrected findings. Expected completion: same day or extend into Wed morning if follow-up tests are required.
- Pre-retest requirements (we will validate prior to connecting): config flags, feature toggles, KV cache cleared, and rotated creds deployed to the sandbox. Please confirm by EOD Mon 28 Jun.
- Evidence transfer: use secure upload link (https://redwood-secure-upload.example.com/s/greenline/PSK-abc123) to send any artifacts. We’ll upload our delta report and verification letter to the same location.
- Deliverables: delta report (HTML/PDF) within 3 business days after retest; verification letter template (verification_template.docx) will be populated and signed by our Head of Security if findings are closed.
- Tracking: we created JIRA:SEC-3121 to track the retest and any follow-ups. We will attach logs and repro steps there.

Attachments to this message: retest_scope_matrix.xlsx (scope by endpoint & tests), verification_template.docx (sample verification letter).

If anything changes on your side (environment or schedule), reply to this thread and we’ll adjust. Otherwise we’ll run the verification as scheduled and follow up with the delta report.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Security Liaison
Redwood Inference
